2026-08-30.summary:
### Audio & Communication
- Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).

### Gameplay & Balance
- Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.

items.text: Explosive ammo now damages monument blockers as intended.
Crates and barrels on both oil rigs now respawn correctly after being looted.
Siege tower doors function properly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam on them.
Fixed a bug where deployable structures could display random skins, ensuring they keep their intended appearance.

2026-08-29.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Explosive ammo now damages monument blockers as intended.

### Monuments & World
- Crates and barrels on both oil rigs now respawn correctly after being looted.

### Siege & Vehicles
- Siege tower doors function properly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam on them.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Fixed a bug where deployable structures could display random skins, ensuring they keep their intended appearance.

items.text: Fixed hull placement, boat creation, and deployable height limits when building boats, preventing errors from assuming ocean level is zero.
Added a new sea turtle rig, introducing sea turtles into the world.
Resolved black player eye rendering issue in Bandit Camp environments.
Store icons now correctly refresh when reopening the store via the escape menu, preventing missing or outdated icons.

2026-08-28.summary:
### Boats & Watercraft
- Fixed hull placement, boat creation, and deployable height limits when building boats, preventing errors from assuming ocean level is zero.

### Animals
- Added a new sea turtle rig, introducing sea turtles into the world.

### Graphics Bugs
- Resolved black player eye rendering issue in Bandit Camp environments.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Store icons now correctly refresh when reopening the store via the escape menu, preventing missing or outdated icons.
